meta.aciklama: #1 Trending GitHub Repo Reduces Token Usage by 6X. Created by Vercel, it’s called agent-desktop.  Comment “VERCEL” for the link.

transkript.t: This GitHub repo just shot to number one on trending and it's called Agent Desktop.
Created by Vercel, it dropped token usage down from 198,000 tokens to 31,000 on the same task.
That's six times fewer tokens used. The trick is that instead of taking screenshots,
it lets the AI agents read your apps through the accessibility tree. The same thing that
screen readers use. The best part, it's free and open source. Comment Vercel for the link.
